objective: Implement deterministic reference-only emergency reduction/flatten planning with explicit authority separation, exact canonical-position binding and reconciliation fail-closed behavior, without bypassing Risk/Firewall/OMS governance or granting Live execution authority.
scope: Bind every emergency request to exact current P21-A position_record_id and position_id
Require OPEN or PARTIALLY_CLOSED canonical position with positive exposure
Require caller-supplied governed emergency decision and authority lineage
Allow EMERGENCY_REDUCE only as a strictly partial reduce-only action
Allow EMERGENCY_FLATTEN only for exactly the full current open quantity
Require OWNER_EXPLICIT_EMERGENCY_FLATTEN authority for full flatten
Permit A5_GOVERNED_REDUCE_ONLY or explicit Owner authority for emergency partial reduction
Treat P16 health/circuit outputs as trigger evidence only, never automatic close authority
Require provider/execution incidents to be reconciled before an exit plan can be emitted
Forbid unresolved UNKNOWN execution status, blind retry and blind cross-broker reroute
Require downstream P20 idempotent reduce-only execution and reconciliation before retry
Produce deterministic content-addressed reference emergency-exit plans
out_of_scope: Automatically deriving an emergency from P16 health/circuit state
Choosing a Live venue, broker, order type or execution algorithm
Direct mutation of P21-A canonical position state
Broker/exchange order placement, cancellation or modification
tests: A5 governed emergency reduction is strictly partial and reduce-only
Owner explicit emergency flatten equals the full current open quantity
Zero, over-close and wrong flatten quantities fail closed
UNKNOWN or unsupported reconciliation state fails closed
P16 trigger evidence alone never grants close authority
Closed or zero-exposure positions fail closed
Plan requires P20 idempotent execution and reconciliation before retry
No blind reroute, broker query, OMS mutation or Live authority is emitted
P21-E evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P21-E package/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P21-A through P21-D remain canonical complete and P21-F remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Authority separation, exact position binding and reconciliation fail-closed tests pass
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
Implementation PR merged and post-merge verified
